module: Depth of field (DOF) as post-processing. Creates the PostEffect "DOFPostEffect" (disabled at the start, PFXAfterBin / UpscaleDispatch) with its sub-effects (DOFBlurY, DOFBlurX, DOFCalcCoC, DOFSmallBlur, DOFFinalPFX) and their shaders. Handles manual or automatic focus (ray cast at the screen center, distance to the player's vehicle if visible, smoothed by a temporal smoother) and sends the shader constants each frame. User settings are read from the $DOFPostFx::* variables (Enable, EnableDebugMode, EnableAutoFocus, BlurMin, BlurMax, FocusRangeMin, FocusRangeMax, BlurCurveNear, BlurCurveFar).
notes: Default values (applyDefaults): Enable true, EnableDebugMode false, EnableAutoFocus false, BlurMin 0.0, BlurMax 0.25, FocusRangeMin 100, FocusRangeMax 250, BlurCurveNear 20, BlurCurveFar 10.
updateDOFSettings passes -BlurCurveNear as the near slope (negative) and BlurCurveFar as the far slope; the max blurs are clamped between 0 and 1.
"Small only" mode: if the maximum blur stays low (canUseSmallOnly), preProcess disables the large blur passes (skipDraw / skip) and sets the macro BNG_DOF_SMALL_ONLY=1 on DOFFinalPFX, to save GPU.
The automatic focus distance uses containerRayCast with the masks Static, Terrain, Vehicle and DynamicShape and falls back to $Param::FarDist when there is no hit.

applyDefaults.desc: Writes the default values of the $DOFPostFx::* variables to the VariableRegistry. Does not enable anything: see updateDOFSettings.

updateDOFSettings.desc: Rereads the $DOFPostFx::* variables, applies the focus parameters, the auto-focus mode and the debug mode to DOFPostEffect, resets the focal distance to 0 then enables or disables the effect according to $DOFPostFx::Enable. No effect if DOFPostEffect does not exist.

dOFPostEffectCallbacks.desc: Callbacks of DOFPostEffect, published on the global DOFPostEffectCallbacks.

onAdd.desc: Called when the effect is added: initializes lerpScale/lerpBias (0.2; 0.3; 0.5), auto-focus disabled, max blurs 0.5, ranges 50 to 500, slopes -5 and 5.

preProcess.desc: Called before the effect is rendered: switches between full mode and "small only" mode and adjusts the sub-effects.

setShaderConsts.desc: Called before execution: updates the automatic focus if it is active, computes the near/far blur equations and sends $dofEqWorld, $dofEqFar, $maxWorldCoC, $maxFarCoC, $dofLerpScale, $dofLerpBias and $isDebugMode to DOFFinalPFX.

dofFinalCallbacks.desc: Callbacks of DOFFinalPFX (global DOFFinalPFXCallbacks, reused if it already exists).

setShaderConsts.desc: In "small only" mode, calls dOFPostEffectCallbacks.setShaderConsts again to update the final shader's constants.
